measurement_contract.embedding: outer-boundary synchronized watermarked generation minus an adjacent same-workload, same-seed, same-length WM-OFF generation; no per-token timing or detection-only cache is active in either member

measurement_contract.output_length: both pair members are forced to the exact max_tokens cap so EOS cannot create unequal work or an incomplete CodeIP message block
measurement_contract.extraction: fresh processor over final generated text; timed region includes final-text tokenization, detector transfers, and complete detect_last(), with no generation state reuse
measurement_contract.normalization: embedding uses completion_tokens; extraction uses independently tokenized final-text tokens; both compute elapsed_seconds * 1,000,000 / reference_tokens
measurement_contract.aggregation: ratio of summed seconds to summed reference tokens; 95% intervals use 10,000 hierarchical bootstrap resamples over workload clusters and runs within clusters
measurement_contract.cuda_synchronization: all CUDA devices visible to the process are synchronized only at outer measurement boundaries
measurement_contract.codeip_variant: released random-message branch without PDA/type predictor
measurement_contract.strength: arithmetic midpoint of each method's RQ1 EEI
measurement_contract.sweet_admission: every measured run must score at least one token and report detector_model_forward entropy provenance
measurement_contract.detector_scope: final generated text only; previous-token detectors consume one seed token and score the remaining tokens

"""
Exception hierarchy for the calculator package.

This module defines the base exception class and specific exceptions
that can be raised during tokenization, parsing, and evaluation phases
of expression processing.
"""

from typing import NoReturn


class CalculatorError(Exception):
    """
    Base exception class for all calculator-related errors.
    
    All other calculator exceptions should inherit from this class.
    """

    def __init__(self, message: str = "An error occurred in the calculator") -> None:
        """
        Initialize the calculator error with an optional message.
        
        Args:
            message: A descriptive error message
        """
        super().__init__(message)


class TokenizationError(CalculatorError):
    """
    Raised when the tokenizer encounters invalid syntax or malformed input.
    
    This exception is raised during the tokenization phase when the input
    string cannot be correctly parsed into valid tokens.
    """

    def __init__(self, message: str = "Failed to tokenize input") -> None:
        """
        Initialize the tokenization error with an optional message.
        
        Args:
            message: A descriptive error message
        """
        super().__init__(message)


class ParseError(CalculatorError

"""
Exception hierarchy for the calculator package.

This module defines the base exception class and specific exceptions
that can be raised during tokenization, parsing, and evaluation phases
of expression processing.
"""

from typing import Final


class CalculatorError(Exception):
    """Base exception class for all calculator-related errors."""
    pass


class TokenizationError(CalculatorError):
    """Raised when an expression cannot be tokenized due to invalid syntax."""
    pass


class ParseError(CalculatorError):
    """Raised when an expression cannot be parsed due to structural issues."""
    pass


class EvaluationError(CalculatorError):
    """Raised when an expression cannot be evaluated due to mathematical errors."""
    pass

    """Raised when the token stream cannot be parsed into a valid RPN expression."""

class EvaluationError(CalculatorError):
    """Raised when evaluating an RPN expression leads to a runtime error."""

/*
 * TokenType.java
 * 
 * Enum representing the different types of tokens in the arithmetic expression tokenizer.
 * Each token type corresponds to a lexical category in the input string.
 */
public enum TokenType {
    NUMBER,     // Represents a numeric literal (integer or decimal)
    PLUS,       // Represents the '+' operator
    MINUS,      // Represents the '-' operator
    STAR,       // Represents the '*' operator
    SLASH,      // Represents the '/' operator
    LPAREN,     // Represents the left parenthesis '('
    RPAREN,     // Represents the right parenthesis ')'
    EOF         // Represents end-of-file, i.e., no more input to tokenize
}
